task:
Manage labels and annotations across Pods in namespace 'sun'.

Setup — create test pods:
  kubectl create ns sun
  kubectl run sun-worker1 --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=worker -- sleep 3600
  kubectl run sun-runner1 --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=runner -- sleep 3600
  kubectl run sun-idle1   --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=idle   -- sleep 3600

Tasks:

  1. Add label 'protected=true' to ALL pods in namespace 'sun' that have label type=worker OR type=runner:
     kubectl label pod -n sun -l type=worker protected=true
     kubectl label pod -n sun -l type=runner protected=true

  2. Add annotation 'protected=do not delete this pod' to all pods that now have label protected=true:
     kubectl annotate pod -n sun -l protected=true 'protected=do not delete this pod'

  3. Verify:
     kubectl get pods -n sun --show-labels
     kubectl describe pod sun-worker1 -n sun | grep protected
hints: kubectl label selects pods using -l flag: kubectl label pod -l type=worker protected=true -n sun
kubectl annotate works similarly: kubectl annotate pod -l protected=true 'key=value' -n sun
kubectl describe pod | grep Annotations  shows annotations
detailed_hints: Label multiple selectors in two commands (OR not supported in single -l expression natively)
Annotation with spaces: 'protected=do not delete this pod'  (single quotes around value)
Verify with: kubectl get pods -n sun -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.metadata.labels}{"\n"}{end}'
setup: kubectl run sun-worker1 --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=worker -- sleep 3600 2>/dev/null || true
kubectl run sun-runner1 --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=runner -- sleep 3600 2>/dev/null || true
kubectl run sun-idle1 --image=busybox:1.35 -n sun --labels=type=idle -- sleep 3600 2>/dev/null || true

validators.command: kubectl get pod sun-worker1 -n sun -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.protected}'
kubectl get pod sun-runner1 -n sun -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.protected}'

validators.description: idle pod does NOT have protected label
validators.command: kubectl get pod sun-idle1 -n sun -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.protected}'
